meaning: ARIIA Section 4 does not ask the institution to hold a TRL. It asks how many innovations are VERIFIED AND RECOMMENDED, and defers the record itself to YUKTI-NIR, a central IIC system. The institution is a pointer, not a system of record.

text: Total no. of Innovations (Verified and Recommended) in Different TRLs (4-9)
meaning: The institution submits a COUNT that it cannot independently verify. 'Verified and Recommended' is done centrally.

text: Existence of IPR Cell / Patent Facilitation Unit / Technology Transfer
meaning: ARIIA 3.3 asks whether an IPR CELL EXISTS. It is a yes/no capability checkbox. It is NOT a patent lifecycle and it does not record a single patent number.

text: Start-ups/Ventures Established and Supported at HEI and Recognitions Received
meaning: Section 5 records that a venture was STARTED and SUPPORTED, plus recognitions received. Supported is unquantified: no amount, no date, no scope of support.
The performance metric is a 1-5 ordinal STAR BAND awarded by the central IIC body, not a continuous innovation score.

text: Institute Own/Internal  |  Number of External Sponsorship/External
meaning: ARIIA forces an EXPENDITURE split between own money and external sponsorship. It is spend already committed, not a funding source, and not a budget the applicant is asking for.
A blank and a 0 sit in the SAME column of the SAME table for consecutive years. Two different sentinels for the same condition, with no legend distinguishing them.
